title: Craftable petrified oak slab
description: Added craft to petrified oak slab
body:
# Visual petrified oak slab

**[Petrified oak slab](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Petrified_Oak_Slab) (it's vanilla) has no crafting and cannot be obtained without cheats, so I added it**
